_note: Wand forms, from a beginner's twig to a staff. A form decides which part slots exist and caps the spine sockets; the shaft material decides how many sockets it naturally has. sockets = min(shaft sockets + socketBonus, maxSockets).

forms.name: Twig
forms.text: A bare stick: shaft only, no grip or cap. Up to 2 crystals. Where every wandwright starts.

forms.name: Wand
forms.text: A grip is bound on. Up to 3 crystals; the grip sets where your charge comes from.

forms.name: Grafted wand
forms.text: Grip, shaft and cap. Up to 4 crystals and 1 flank if the shaft has room.

forms.name: Master wand
forms.text: A master's work. Up to 6 crystals and every flank the shaft can carry.

forms.name: Staff
forms.text: Two-handed: no off-hand ward. +2 sockets over the shaft (up to 7), +25% power, slower casts.
